recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-28349 unless the work group later reopens the naming/modeling question; any future change should preserve the distinction from the removed Ingredient.description element.
issue_request: FHIR-28349 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core MedicinalProductIngredient/Ingredient. It asked to add a note element for additional information about a particular ingredient component, such as removal during processing or adjustment for loss on drying. The final application kept the markdown 0..1 capability and, after FHIR-I naming review, used Ingredient.comment rather than Ingredient.note or Ingredient.description.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Commit 6c2a9ba943 first added the requested markdown 0..1 content as Ingredient.description. Jira comments then recorded the naming concern, FHIR-I approval for using comment, and full application with the name comment; commit 24da22b3ea renamed the element to Ingredient.comment, and commit 701913e842 added the build suppression confirming this non-Annotation comment element was intentional.
additional_context: Ingredient is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini, and fhir.ini maps the old MedicinalProductIngredient artifact name to Ingredient. The current source/ingredient/structuredefinition-Ingredient.xml contains Ingredient.comment with markdown type, cardinality 0..1, and the examples from the Jira request. suppressed-messages.txt contains the Ingredient.comment Annotation-warning suppression. The earlier FHIR-31810 decision removed the old Ingredient.description element; an existing combined-branch audit for FHIR-31810 confirms that later FHIR-28349 intentionally added a separate comment element rather than restoring description.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because the authoritative current core source already implements the final WG outcome for FHIR-28349, including the approved element name, type, cardinality, examples, and build warning suppression. An empty audit commit was published on the combined branch.
